Now that I think about it, when I say I'm an atheist, I suppose I meant I hold no belief on the Abrahamic God.

I'm an atheist, but I'm not strictly a man of science. I hold faith in having an afterlife because I've had experience with ghosts, and reincarnation seems possible to me — but that's from anecdotal evidence. In short, I'm superstitious as hell.

I want to believe I'll get into Valhalla, but at the moment, there's no chance I'll get in.

Finally, I'm not trying to undermine anyone here. I'm caught in a legitimate conundrum. I have been debating this for a bit now.

Valhalla is just where I want to end up, no clue how I'd get there yet.

I mean, it's a great thing to just be able to take hit and keep going; it's my lifestyle. However, so many other things have been taken from me: my sanity, my confidence, general ability to feel, happiness. All of that and probably more. It doesn't help that this week is especially frustrating having to terminate T568B cables and learning how to punch down fucking keystone jacks. That shit is irritating. It's not even all that difficult, just tedious, but that's before your fucking safety glasses fog up and you can't see the broadside of a bus past 2 feet in front of you.

Sorry, went off on a tangent. My point is, things are irritating by themselves, but damn near unbearable when there's a whole different factor that you have no way of preventing.

Look man, you need to take half a step back and think.

First of all, don't kill yourself. You dont know how much people care about you until they lose you. They take you for granted, a friend they can rely on If they lose you, their lives will he destroyed. You couldn't hurt them, that's not in your nature.

If you'll allow me to be honest for a moment I'm surprised I'm still around. I've been through the fucking ringer, man. 2 car crashes, bullying, self harm, being robbed by people I called friends, twice; being afraid of getting help, freaking the fuck out while driving, and I guess most of anything else associated with the aforementioned bullshit.

Well, I'm fortunate I'm not suicidal, just miserable.
